title: Prescribed Tape Write
statement: For any optional Boolean symbol $s$, tape contents $\tau:\mathbb Z\to\text{Option}(\text{Bool})$, and cell position $z\in\mathbb Z$, applying the write operation with $s$ prescribed gives the tape contents obtained by replacing the value at $z$ by $s$ and leaving every other cell unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $\tau$ maps integers to optional Boolean symbols
